newsitem.title: USA: Northwest plane skids off runway in North Dakota.
newsitem.headline: Northwest plane skids off runway in North Dakota.

text.p: A Northwest Airlines DC-9 landing from Minneapolis skidded off the runway and into a snowbank at Grand Forks International Airport Sunday night, an airport spokeswoman said Monday.
No one was injured in the accident but two of the 93 passengers on board were hurt when they slipped on ice on the tarmac while walking back to the terminal, spokeswoman Heidi Ward said.
Federal investigators were looking into the cause of the skid, which left the aircraft stuck in the snowbank until tow trucks retrieved it early Monday, she said.
The airplane landed at about 9:15 p.m. CST (10:15 EST). The passengers were evacuated through emergency exits over the wings of the plane.
